## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 417 image captures during February 2019. This activity represents the work completed by the site during the reporting month. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 417 captures, 8 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.9. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The result provides the site’s image-quality measure for February 2019.

## Grading

Grading identified 65 referable results from the activity recorded at North City Eye Clinic. The median lag between capture and grading was 7 days. This measure summarises the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. Together, the referable findings and the median lag provide an overview of grading activity for February 2019.
